d: A bodice block (bodice sloper) drafted with the classic British Bray method

chestEase.d: How much ease to add at the bust line. The book drafts 10 cm, of which shaping the waist takes back a few centimetres

seatEase.d: How much ease to add at the hip line. The book drafts 6 cm, and puts all of it on the front panel

waistEase.d: How much ease to leave at the waist before the darts are shaped. The book allows 3 to 6 cm on the full pattern

waistFit.d: Whether to shape the waist with center-line slant, side-seam intake and darts, or to leave the plain block with its simple side-seam taper

backWidthPct.d: How far the across-back width departs from the book's own grade for this bust size. Round-shouldered figures need more, erect figures less

chestWidthPct.d: How far the across-chest width departs from the book's own grade for this bust size. It moves opposite to the back width as posture changes

bustDartWidth.d: How far the shoulder/bust dart, where it opens on the shoulder seam, departs from the book's own grade for this bust size
